standards.title: A GUI must never trigger collection merely by being loaded or launched
QC decisions must be atomic, provenance-bearing, append-only, and race-guarded
A resolved QC decision must leave the active queue immediately, via read-side filtering
A GUI with a QC queue must expose a 'recently QC'd' view backed by the QC archive
Where a production/experimental maturity tier exists, promotion must be an explicit config change, not a GUI action or an automatic decision
A bulk 'run all' collector control must exclude non-production collectors by default
Manual collector controls must respect and visibly expose collector lifecycle/authority policy
Source operational health must be independently expressible from coverage/output
A run's status must not collapse pipeline stages the backend already distinguishes
Every ambiguous timestamp must identify both its semantic role and its timezone
Where delivery exists, delivery state must be inspectable independently from discovery/review state
Primary workflow must not imply unobserved health
News/lead-based Clanks: the QC vocabulary's fourth terminal action marks the item no longer distinct/novel
News-family Clanks: a live editorial intake/review surface must be reachable directly or via one obvious action
SKU review systems must preserve a distinct availability-negative disposition

change_policy: Post-freeze normative UI changes go through normal governance and result in a new standard, a versioned revision, a supersession, or a retirement. This manifest and the ui-standards-v1.0 tag are immutable historical records and must never be rewritten; future corpus state may legitimately diverge from v1.0.
